lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Girl, let's get out of here. They will be busy for a while.

lines.speaker: Ellen
lines.text: Thank you, Lady. Thank you so much.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: You look so bad, sweet girl.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Find Miss Ruth, she will take good care of you.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: She might be at the gates at the top of this section.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Frieda, call me Frieda. You can do it, sweetie.

lines.speaker: Ezra
lines.text: Ellen is going to need my help.

lines.speaker: Frieda
lines.text: Remember to find Miss Ruth at the gates up ahead.
